cs.t: To add another data point for anyone looking for help- I connected two Displayport monitors to my M1 macbook with a Plugable Displaylink hub. The hub I chose also has 2 HDMI ports if I ever got new monitors, plus 6 USB-A ports, an ethernet port and an audio jack. What it doesn't do, is power your laptop. I don't believe any Displaylink hub can do that. $159 and Plugable has other port configurations to choose from as well:  https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B08B6CZ29Q/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b...
cs.th: My journey for dual displays with my M1 Pro Mac (2021)
